authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 2.13, 20.1 and 20.4.52
scope: Apply the existing version-aware BLOCK_HEADER wire and frame observers to the model and paper blocks in each locally generated two-element AC1012 dictionary collision pair.
checks: Both drawings' two block frames bind to their physical file, CRC-checked framing, source version, handle and import generation. Their complete observed bodies and control, extension, xref, block, first, last and end handle spans match the parsed records.

The model block first and last entity both resolve to LINE 0x2C; the paper block has null endpoints. Body edits, parent edits, each present handle-role mutation, changed frame bytes and changed generation are rejected; the unchanged source passes again.
Three focused CTests pass in 0.25 seconds: shared relative-handle vectors and the two optional generated-sample checks. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: These are selected source-wire and local parser consistency checks. They do not establish whole-file graph closure, AutoCAD normal-open, clone semantics, native DXF output or general support.
